verdict.rationale: Superhuman shows some multi-item operations. Its MCP integration can 'handle every follow-up with one prompt', drafting and sending nudges across many emails. A community user reports you can trash or mark done all messages from the same sender, and split-inbox lets you process emails of the same type together. However, no general bulk-select or bulk-action capability is documented. missing for 10: documented general multi-select/bulk actions (archive/label/move across arbitrary selections), first-party docs on bulk operations via MCP or command palette, limits/scale details, independent hands-on corroboration of AI-driven bulk actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Handle every follow-up with one prompt. Superhuman Mail can check which emails have been read, draft all the nudges, and send when each recipient is most likely to open it.
When deleting, you can trash or mark done all messages from the same sender.
you can focus on a specific topic — and get through emails of the same type, at the same time.
